description:
### Gboard Clipboard History (v1.0.0)

- Direct SQLite reader for Gboard clips table (`gboard_clipboard.db`).
- Launcher icon for direct access from app drawer.
- Entry in Gboard Settings -> Clipboard.
- Read-only ContentProvider endpoint (`content://com.sj010.gboardclipboard.history/clips`) with token and signature authentication.
- Primary clip backfill when Gboard regains active keyboard focus.
- Text file export and sensitive clip filtering.

Compatible with Gboard v18.0.0 through v18.4.1+.
